event_chain.summary: Documents with SSNs published on city website

summary: In November 2025 the City of Daytona Beach, Florida published a new webpage showing city purchasing-card transactions and receipts (created in response to a WFTV investigation into card spending). The posted documents included unredacted names, home addresses and Social Security numbers, e.g. on a travel expense document. After WFTV raised it, the city took the page down to redact and repost the documents and its attorney reviewed breach-notification requirements.
